## What & why

<!-- What does this change and why? Link any issue: Closes #123 -->

## Type of change

- [ ] feat (new feature)
- [ ] fix (bug fix)
- [ ] docs
- [ ] refactor / chore
- [ ] breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] One thing per PR (atomic), with a clear description above
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat:`, `fix:`, …); it becomes the merge commit's subject
- [ ] Every commit is signed (verified), Conventional and meaningful
- [ ] Every commit has one author: no `Co-authored-by` trailer, no AI attribution
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing
- [ ] Lint/format clean
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased** (if user-facing)
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] No em dashes

<!-- Merged with a merge commit, never squashed or rebased; the branch is deleted on merge. -->
